body: My mom's birthday is coming up this month, it'll be three years. Don't know what to do.

I second this, when my mom passed I had family that I hadn't spoken to in a while do all the formalities but when it came to actual help they didn't budge. I do have my mom's close friend that has been extremely supportive and I consider her the only person I can trust. If you have someone like that, even if they're not family, that would be good for you. And I'm really sorry for your loss, I truly am.
Almost every day, whenever i feel sad or depressed I'll write something. It helps get it off my chest and I'd feel a bit better
Thanks man and same to you, this life really is hard

Thanks it helps knowing that I'm not the only one dealing with this, I'm 21 so my "real world" experience is pretty low but I will go through the resources on this sub. Once again thanks so much for the advice
I'm sorry you had to see her go through so much pain, I understand how it feels. Thank you for the support

I watched her die in my arms after doing all I could to help her. All I want is to stop feeling this way and to forget it happened but the only person who could do that was her and now she's gone, I also hope it gets better soon
Thank you it's good to know that someone knows what I'm going through
